visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair sits comfortably on a gray couch, wearing a sleeveless brown top. She addresses the camera with high energy and active hand gestures. The background is a minimalist white wall. (2) A sequence of fashion photographs is displayed, featuring celebrities Bella Hadid, Selena Gomez, and Shu Hua, each wearing trendy outfits and designer accessories. (3) The scene returns to the woman on the couch, who continues her narrative with a friendly smile and expressive eye contact. (4) Close-up shots feature a pair of soft pink satin shoes with elegant ribbon laces; a hand enters the frame to adjust the ribbon and showcase the material. (5) The woman holds a red Mary-Jane style shoe, pointing out the knitted texture of the upper and the white strap detail. (6) A full-body shot shows the woman in a red polo and dark denim culottes standing in a modern room with a record player and tall speakers. She showcases the red shoes by posing and rotating. (7) Close-up shots focus on the shoe's interior and a finger pressing into the thick, cushiony insole to demonstrate its softness. (8) A rapid editing montage follows, showing the woman in various outfits—a white maxi skirt and black top—paired with cream and pink shoes. (9) The woman holds up three pairs of shoes simultaneously (pink, black, and cream) while summarizing the key points of her review. (10) The video concludes with a close-up of her talking, overlaid with large pink and white text announcing a giveaway and a store opening event.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with short black hair and bangs, wearing casual tops including a brown sleeveless shirt and a red polo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear female voice begins speaking with high energy and perfect articulation, set against a quiet studio background. No music is present initially. (2) A bright, rhythmic electronic pop track fades in at a low volume under the narration. The tempo is steady and upbeat. (3) The speaker's pitch rises and fall naturally as she discusses her curiosity about the brand. A faint soft thud SFX is heard as she handles a shoe. (4) The audio cuts quickly between descriptions of shoe comfort; the music remains a consistent bed, maintaining a high-arousal atmosphere. (5) A distinct soft percussive sound occurs when her finger presses the insole, emphasizing the tactile quality. (6) The video concludes with a high-pitched, enthusiastic invitation for viewers to join a giveaway, with a final rhythmic musical swell before ending.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Celebrity Context -> Personal Review -> Product Features -> Try-on Montage -> CTA/Store Announcement
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional endorsement for the shoe brand VIVAIA. It utilizes a personal vlog-style narrative to build trust, showing the creator's genuine interest and subsequent purchase history. By demonstrating comfort features (machine washable, cushioned insole) and providing styling inspiration through try-on shots, it aims to drive sales and traffic to a new store location in Taipei.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker explicitly states she is collaborating with VIVAIA and provides detailed product benefits, a giveaway, and store opening information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality production combining direct-to-camera address with professionally lit B-roll and try-on sequences.
